verified: edh-next-91 review (top-rank part 7; EDHREC rank 14,104, top 20,000, opened by the owner), by hand against the Oracle text and CR 120.2, 510.2, 603.2: the third ability triggers on any combat damage dealt to its controller, from any source (event damage with the player 'you' as recipient and no source, the same event as 'you are dealt combat damage'), and removes one indestructible counter from Risona itself. The renderer says it either way (family damage-dealt-to-you).

edh-next-91 review (EDHREC rank 14,710), by hand against the Oracle text and CR 201.5c, 603.4, 608.2c, 111.4: 'Drizzt' is the card itself (the first word of a legendary name whose apostrophe is inside a word, selfref.ts); the enters trigger creates the legendary 4/1 Cat token named Guenhwyvar with trample; the dies trigger has the intervening if 'it had power greater than Drizzt's power' (the dying creature as it last existed against Drizzt now, checked again on resolution per the ruling of 2021-07-23) and puts that many +1/+1 counters as the difference.

edh-next-91 review (EDHREC rank 13,636), by hand against the Oracle text and CR 101.4, 608.2c, 608.2d: the caster returns one creature card from their graveyard; each opponent in turn order may return one creature card from their own graveyard (a choice of up to one, then all chosen cards move together); then, for each opponent who did (the count of cards the opponents chose), the caster returns one more creature card (a repeat of that count). Rulings 2013-10-17.

edh-next-91 review (EDHREC rank 14,990), by hand against the Oracle text and CR 601.2i, 603.2, 701.5a: a cast event of a noncreature spell that is the first such spell cast in the turn by ANY player (nthMatching with anyCaster, counted from the history of the turn, so a spell cast before the Gargoyle entered still counts: ruling 2005-10-01); the trigger counters that spell.

edh-next-91 review (EDHREC rank 14,153), by hand against the Oracle text and CR 608.2c, 701.9a, 122.1: an optional choice of any number of land cards in the hand, discarded together; the same number (what the discard did, resultCount) of +1/+1 counters go on Nantuko Cultivator and of cards are drawn, as one resolution (ruling 2019-06-14); declining counts 0.
